valueRules.shape: { join: 'and' | 'or', rules: (FilterRule | FilterGroup)[] }, where a FilterRule is { field, filter } and `filter` is the FilterDescriptor `table` edits in a column header, unchanged
valueRules.engine: @slotted/core/filter — group.ts holds the tree, the predicate, the sentence and the codec; the family invents no vocabulary
valueRules.firstLevel: a first-level rule for a field is the object a column header reads and writes through ruleFor and withRuleFor, so a screen offering both edits one value
valueRules.inactive: a leaf without every operand its operator needs is dropped before the join, and a group left empty is dropped with it — normalizeFilterGroup, the engine's rule one level up
valueRules.null: a value with no active rule is null, which is what a consumer stores and a URL carries
valueRules.unknownField: a rule over a field the consumer no longer declares is kept, drawn as a chip with the key and data-invalid, removable, and never evaluated

query.value: string, the one condition that belongs to no column
query.predicate: createSearchPredicate: a contains text condition against every searchable field, or-joined, through the collator the typed conditions use
query.delay: queryDelay in milliseconds, default 320, debounces the request under apply=live; under manual the query joins the draft
query.escape: Escape in the search clears the query when it holds one, reason clear

pattern.title: Toolbar Pattern
pattern.chipsTitle: Grid Pattern, the layout grid half
pattern.root: role=search rather than role=toolbar, because the pattern asks a toolbar to avoid controls whose operation requires the pair of arrow keys used for toolbar navigation, and a text box is one
pattern.departure: the optional 'focus is set on the control that last had focus' is taken for the bar and the chips; the grid pattern's in-place Enter editing is not a chip's — Enter opens the same popover a pointer gets

wiring.root: role=search with aria-label from labels.bar unless the consumer wrote one
wiring.bar: role=toolbar, aria-label labels.filters, one tab stop, roving tabindex from @slotted/core/focus
wiring.chips: role=grid with one role=row and a role=gridcell per chip, aria-label labels.applied, one tab stop
wiring.pill: button, aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, data-filtered while the field holds a rule
wiring.chip: tag worn as data-ui; accessible name '<field label>: <sentence>'; the remove control is tag's
wiring.builder: drawer worn as data-ui, titled labels.builder

surfaces.chip: the same popover, opened from the chip
surfaces.builder: drawer editing the whole tree, on every width
surfaces.summary: below the narrow breakpoint the pills and the chips fold behind one button, 'Filters (n)', which opens the builder
surfaces.reason: a tree with a nested group needs a column; a popover anchored to a pill has neither the height nor the anchor for it

apply.live: a popover commits every change and the engine's inactive rule keeps a half-typed condition out; the builder commits on Apply; removing a chip, Clear and choosing a preset commit at once
apply.manual: everything goes to a draft; apply commits with reason submit, reset discards, data-dirty on the root meanwhile; Enter in an operand applies
apply.escape: closes the surface and discards what it held

required.rule: a field with required: true has a defaultValue; Clear returns it to that value rather than to nothing
required.refusal: a required field whose rule is inactive refuses Apply under manual and refuses removal under live: data-invalid on its chip, labels.required(field) associated, focus moved to it
required.pinned: a required field is pinned whether or not the consumer said so

preset.select: choosing one replaces the value, reason select; the value changing afterwards keeps the preset current and marks the root data-dirty
preset.save: onPresetSave(value) from the builder, and nothing else about saving — the name is typed in a dialog the application owns

responsive.container: filter-bar, inline-size, on the root; the grid is on frame, one element in, because a container query cannot restyle the element it measures
responsive.wide: 64rem and up: search, toolbar, the consumer's controls and the count on one line, the chips under it
responsive.medium: 36rem to 64rem: the search shares its line with the consumer's controls and the count; the toolbar takes a line of its own; the chips under both
responsive.narrow: 36rem, literal by rule 4 of the token foundation: the search alone, then summary beside the consumer's controls, then the count; pills and chips hidden

sticky.on: position: sticky at --slotted-page-sticky-top; the root measures itself into --slotted-filter-bar-size and republishes --slotted-page-sticky-top for what follows as the sum, which is the rule section established and the briefing binds this family to

announcements.count: labels.count(count, total) — the count part is the live region
announcements.applied: the field and its sentence, the same text the chip shows
announcements.cleared: labels.cleared, and for a required field its default's sentence

keyboard.effect: search, then the bar, then the chips, then what follows
keyboard.focus: into the bar or the chips: the last-focused control, else the first enabled

keyboard.effect: previous / next control in the bar, previous / next chip; wraps; mirrored under dir=rtl
first / last control in the bar or the chips
on a pill, a chip or add: opens the editor
keyboard.focus: the first control inside the surface

keyboard.effect: on a chip: removes the rule, reason remove; a required field's chip refuses and takes data-invalid
keyboard.focus: the next chip, else the previous, else add

keyboard.effect: in the search: clears the query when it holds one, reason clear. In a surface: closes and discards
keyboard.focus: unchanged; the trigger, for a surface

keyboard.effect: in an operand: what Apply does in that surface
when set, focuses the search unless focus is in an editable element; default none

declined.sort: table and data-grid hold sort with a model of their own; a select in the end slot is the composition
declined.columnChooser: column-manager, docs/component-features.md §12; its trigger goes in the end slot
declined.queryLanguage: EUI and AG Grid both build a parser and an autocompleter over field names; the tree is the value here and the builder its editor. A product that wants the expression form parses to FilterGroup and passes value
declined.applyingRows: the consumer, or data-grid — createFilterGroupPredicate and createSearchPredicate are what it applies
declined.presetLifecycle: saving, renaming and deleting a preset are the application's; onPresetSave is the one request

dataAttributes.data-filtered: on a pill while its field holds an active rule
dataAttributes.data-dirty: on the root while the draft, or the value against the current preset, differs
dataAttributes.data-apply: live or manual, on the root
dataAttributes.data-kind: on a rule, the field's kind
dataAttributes.data-depth: on a group, its nesting depth from 0

literals.--slotted-filter-bar-chip-max: 18rem: no scale holds a measure, and container owns the page's
literals.--slotted-filter-bar-editor-size: 18rem: the width of the rule a pill opens, because a popover shrink-wraps
literals.narrow breakpoint: 36rem, inside @container, where a custom property is invalid
